 As a Dm I know it is hard to plan one campaign for a few players, so the depth and cohesiveness of the world and game you put on each and every year for the number of players you do is Unbelievable. I can't imagine the workload behind the scenes for both you and the other DMs. But having seen you in chats and drawing late into the night for the weeks leading up to the game your sheer love and dedication to your world is evident. I can’t speak for others but I suspect this to be true for many, this game has been a lifeline to me through hard times, and has legitimately taught me how to live my life better. When I came into Roanoke in season 2 being nowhere near the origins of the game and knowing nobody I still felt welcome, but not only that the DMs and even other players treated me like a person instead of a kid. My appreciation for the time, thought, and work you have put into this game is unending. I really just want you to know how much this game and the work you have put in has done for me and to I'm sure so many others, it is beyond the scope of what any D&D game could be expected to do.
